name: US cities
blurb: American cities that fly their own flag

flags.name: New York City
flags.about: Most populous city in the United States
flags.story: The flags of New York City include the flag of New York City, the respective flags of the boroughs of The Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, and Staten Island, and flags of certain city departments.

flags.name: Chicago
flags.about: City and county seat of Cook County, and largest city in State of Illinois, United States of America
flags.story: The flag of Chicago consists of two light blue horizontal bars, or stripes, on a field of white, each bar one-sixth the height of the full flag, and placed slightly less than one-sixth of the way from the top and bottom.

flags.name: Houston
flags.about: Seat of Harris County, and largest city in State of Texas, United States
flags.story: The flag of Houston, Texas consists of a large white five-pointed star on a blue background with the city's seal set within the star. The flag was adopted in 1915.

flags.name: Phoenix
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Arizona and seat of Maricopa County

flags.name: San Diego
flags.about: Seat of San Diego County, California, United States; second-largest city in California
flags.story: The flag of San Diego consists of three vertical bands; colored from left to right; dark red, white and gold.

flags.name: Dallas
flags.about: City in the state of Texas, United States
flags.story: The current flag of Dallas, Texas, was adopted February 13, 1967. The flag was designed by E. L. Gilchrist.

flags.name: San Jose
flags.about: City and county seat of Santa Clara County, California, United States
flags.story: The current flag of San Jose, California, features a triband of gold on top, white in the middle, and blue on the bottom with the city's official seal in the center. It has been the official flag since 1984.

flags.name: Austin
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Texas and seat of Travis County
flags.story: The city flag of Austin, Texas consists of a white field with the seal of Austin without the surrounding circle of text. Below the seal of Austin is the text "CITY OF AUSTIN", written in blue and arched with the ends facing upwards.

flags.name: Fort Worth
flags.about: City and county seat of Tarrant County, Texas, United States

flags.name: Columbus
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Ohio and seat of Franklin County, also located in Delaware and Fairfield counties

credit.artist: The original uploader was Alex43223 at Wikimedia Commons .

flags.name: Indianapolis
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Indiana and seat of Marion County
flags.story: The flag of Indianapolis has a dark blue field with a white five-pointed star pointing upwards in the center. Around the star is a circular field in red.

flags.name: Charlotte
flags.about: City in and county seat of Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, United States
flags.story: The flag of Charlotte, North Carolina, was adopted in 1929 and consists of a white saltire on a blue field, with the city seal in the center. A secondary flag, with a green field and a white crown in the center, was introduced in 1985 and is primarily used at city government buildings.

flags.name: San Francisco
flags.about: City and county in California, United States
flags.story: The Flag of the City and County of San Francisco contains a rising phoenix in the center, often assumed to refer to the city's recovery from the 1906 earthquake and subsequent fires.

credit.artist: Original Author: Vector-Images.com Converted from EPS to SVG by: Oren neu dag

flags.name: Denver
flags.about: Consolidated city-county and capital of the U.S. state of Colorado
flags.story: The flag of the City and County of Denver was designed by a North High School student, Margaret Overbeck, and adopted in 1926.

flags.name: Washington, D.C.
flags.about: Capital city of the United States of America
flags.story: The flag of the District of Columbia is the official flag representing the district. Consisting of three red stars above two red bars on a white background, it is an armorial banner based on the coat of arms of Lawrence Washington of Sulgrave Manor, Northamptonshire, England, in 1592.

flags.name: Nashville
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Tennessee and seat of Davidson County
flags.story: The city flag of Nashville, Tennessee consists of the city's seal on a white disc surrounded by a field of blue, with a strip of gold on the fly.

flags.name: Oklahoma City
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Oklahoma and seat of Oklahoma County

flags.name: El Paso
flags.about: City in and county seat of El Paso County, Texas, United States
flags.story: The current city flag of El Paso, Texas is an augmentation of the city's seal in the center of a dark blue field, which has been in place since 1962.

flags.name: Boston
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Massachusetts and seat of Suffolk County
flags.story: The flag of Boston consists of a sky blue field and the seal of the city of Boston, Massachusetts, United States, in the center. The flag is sometimes flown in a darker shade of blue, more of a turquoise. It was designed in 1913 and adopted by the Boston City Council on January 29, 1917.

flags.name: Portland
flags.about: Seat of Multnomah County, and largest city in state of Oregon, United States
flags.story: The city flag of Portland, Oregon, consists of a green field on which is placed a white four-pointed star from which radiate blue stripes, each bordered by L-shaped yellow elements (esquarres). Narrow white fimbriations separate the blue and yellow elements from each other and from the green background.

flags.name: Las Vegas
flags.about: Seat of Clark County, and largest city in state of Nevada, United States
flags.story: The flag of Las Vegas consists of blue field with a diagonal gray stripe running from the top of the hoist to the bottom of the fly. The city seal was designed by Richard Thompson, adopted on March 16, 1966, and is located on the canton breaking the stripe.

flags.name: Detroit
flags.about: City in and county seat of Wayne County, and largest city in State of Michigan, United States
flags.story: The flag of Detroit was designed in 1907 by David E. Heineman and was officially adopted as the city's flag in 1948. Its design has been slightly altered several times in the years since, the most recent in 2000.

flags.name: Memphis
flags.about: City in and county seat of Shelby County, Tennessee, United States
flags.story: The flag of Memphis, Tennessee, was designed by Albert Mallory III, then a student at the Memphis Academy of Arts, and was formally adopted by the city commission in July 1963.

flags.name: Milwaukee
flags.about: City in and county seat of Milwaukee County, and largest city in State of Wisconsin, United States
flags.story: The flag of Milwaukee was adopted by its Common Council in 1954.

flags.name: Albuquerque
flags.about: City and county seat of Bernalillo County, New Mexico, United States and the largest city in the state
flags.story: The flag of Albuquerque is the official municipal flag of the city of Albuquerque, New Mexico. The design is a red field with yellow elements.

flags.name: Sacramento
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of California and seat of Sacramento County
flags.story: The flag of Sacramento, California, was adopted on August 15, 1989. It consists of two different shades of blue, separated by a wavy line. On the top-right and bottom-left are two half-oblongs - one green and one yellow. On the bottom is the official name "CITY OF SACRAMENTO" in the font of "Century Gothic".

flags.name: Kansas City
flags.about: City in Missouri, United States, that is one of two county seats of Jackson County and the largest city in Missouri
flags.story: The flag of Kansas City, Missouri, simply known as the KC Flag, consists of two horizontal bars, red above blue, with a white stylized fountain emblem. It is the seventh city flag for Kansas City.

flags.name: Atlanta
flags.about: Capital city of the U.S. state of Georgia and seat of Fulton County, also located in DeKalb County
flags.story: The city flag of Atlanta consists of a blue background with the seal of Atlanta in the center; the seal consists of only the colors blue and gold. The seal depicts a phoenix rising from a fire with text surrounding it; the phoenix is used to represent Atlanta rising from ashes after the American Civil War.
